objective: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.

description: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders.  I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.
You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
progress: Battle hard, <name>. And do not despair, for despair is evil's greatest weapon.
completion: Your skill in combat, <name>, can not be doubted. Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
